description: This file is the main entry point for the rusEfi ECU console application. It sets up the user interface, manages connection states, and initializes various panels and components for user interaction with the ECU firmware, including logs, gauges, fuel tuning, and sensors. It also handles application lifecycle events such as startup and shutdown.

classes.name: Launcher
classes.description: Main class that initializes and manages the rusEfi ECU console application's user interface, connection, and lifecycle.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point. Processes command-line arguments, initializes configuration, and starts the GUI.

methods.name: awtCode
methods.description: Sets up the user interface components on the AWT Event Dispatch Thread.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Updates the main window title based on connection status and firmware version.

methods.name: windowOpenedHandler
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the main application window is opened, including establishing connections and initializing components.

methods.name: windowClosedHandler
methods.description: Handles cleanup actions when the main window is closed, including saving configuration and closing communication channels.

methods.name: tabbedPaneAdd
methods.description: Adds a tab with a specified title, component, and associated action listener to the tabbed pane.
